facts.fact: Nara’s deer are wild and protected. The publisher permits only special shika senbei crackers and warns against teasing or grabbing animals; small children may feel overwhelmed.
facts.location: Visible source paragraph/table containing: shika senbei
facts.excerpt: , they are protected as Natural Monuments, and revered as holy animals in Nara. The deer are wild, but they enjoy eating the special crackers called “shika senbei”, that are sold around Nara Park, and will approach humans. These crackers are especially made to be safe for the deer and are the only food you can give them. Sometimes they can get impatient to eat the crackers, so be careful with small children, who can feel overwhelmed. Avoid teasing the deer or trying to grab them. If you have no food, they will usually leave you alone, so hold up your hands
